title: phanera pterocalyx
intro: Phanera pterocalyx, commonly known as the "Indian lotus tree," is a plant species within the family Moraceae. The plant is used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various skin conditions. Phanera pterocalyx is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-diarrheal, anti-spasmodic, and anti-helmintic properties. The bioactive constituents of Phanera pterocalyx include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
